title: 搜救犬退役与狗狗的超级鼻子
pdf: https://michael-podcast-1513696684.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/vol49/Vol49_晚读讲义_搜救犬退役与狗狗的超级鼻子_v2.pdf
pdfName: Vol49_晚读讲义_搜救犬退役与狗狗的超级鼻子_v2.pdf

blocks.en: Hello, young explorers, and welcome back to Michael's Morning Listening! Today we meet heroes with four legs and wet noses. First, five rescue dogs who have retired — and found new families. Then, the secret inside a dog's nose: why can it smell things we cannot even imagine? Ready? Let's go!
blocks.title: 开场白
blocks.cn: 你好，小小探险家们，欢迎回到 Michael 的早听晚读！今天，我们认识长着四条腿、湿鼻子的英雄。首先，五只已经退役的搜救犬——它们找到了新家。然后，狗狗鼻子里的秘密：为什么它能闻到我们根本想象不到的东西？准备好了吗？出发！

blocks.en: In Ecuador, five rescue dogs have just retired. Their names are Ares, Kratos, Zeus, Titan and Gaia. For seven years, they worked with firefighters, looking for people after earthquakes and landslides. They were German shepherds and golden retrievers, and their approach was simple: follow the nose, never give up.
blocks.title: 退役搜救犬的新生活
blocks.cn: 在厄瓜多尔，五只搜救犬刚刚退役。它们的名字是阿瑞斯、克拉托斯、宙斯、泰坦和盖娅。七年来，它们和消防员一起，在地震和山体滑坡后寻找人们。它们是德国牧羊犬和金毛寻回犬，方法很简单：跟着鼻子走，永不放弃。

blocks.en: It was not easy. They climbed over broken stones and searched through dust, rain and heat. More than once, a dog found a person under the stones — and the rescuers could feel the person's pulse. He was alive! The dogs did not just save lives; they gave families hope again.
blocks.title: 退役搜救犬的新生活
blocks.cn: 这可不是轻松的活儿。它们爬过破碎的石块，在尘土、雨水和高温中搜寻。不止一次，一只狗狗在石块下找到了人——救援人员摸到了这个人的脉搏。他还活着！狗狗们不只是救了命，还让一个个家庭重新有了希望。

blocks.en: Now the five heroes are off duty. At a ceremony, the firefighters said thank you, and each dog went home with a new family. Gaia's new owner, Valeria, said she could not believe her new pet used to save lives. Now Gaia's job is easier: long walks, good food, and a soft bed. After years of hard work, these heroes have earned their rest.
blocks.title: 退役搜救犬的新生活
blocks.cn: 现在，五位英雄卸任了。在一个仪式上，消防员们说了谢谢，每只狗狗都跟着新家庭回了家。盖娅的新主人瓦莱里娅说，她简直不敢相信自己的新宠物曾经救过人。现在盖娅的日子轻松多了：长长的散步、好吃的食物，还有一张软软的床。经过多年的辛苦工作，这些英雄值得好好休息。

blocks.en: So how does a dog's nose do such amazing work? Here is one amazing aspect: a dog's sense of smell is 10,000 to 100,000 times more sensitive than ours. Inside a dog's nose there are up to 300 million smell receptors — tiny scent sensors. We humans have only about six million. And the part of a dog's brain that reads smells is about 40 times bigger than ours.
blocks.title: 狗狗鼻子的秘密
blocks.cn: 那么，狗狗的鼻子是怎么做到的呢？先说一个了不起的方面：狗狗的嗅觉比我们灵敏一万到十万倍。狗狗的鼻子里有多达三亿个嗅觉感受器——小小的气味传感器。而我们人类只有大约六百万个。而且狗狗大脑里负责读气味的部分，比我们的大约大四十倍。

blocks.en: How does it work? When a dog sniffs, air goes into two rooms inside its nose: one for breathing, one for smelling. The smelling room is full of soft tissue that traps scent, so the smell stays after the dog breathes out. That is why a dog can follow a trail hours later — and tell which way a person walked, sniffing left, then right.
blocks.title: 狗狗鼻子的秘密
blocks.cn: 它是怎么工作的呢？狗狗一吸气，空气进入鼻子里的两个小房间：一个用来呼吸，一个用来闻气味。闻气味的房间里长满了柔软的组织，能留住气味，所以狗狗呼气后气味还在。这就是为什么狗狗几个小时后还能追踪气味——还能分辨一个人往哪个方向走，先闻左边，再闻右边。

blocks.en: Scientists conducted an experiment: they trained dogs to smell sickness in people's breath — and the dogs could do it! Dogs can smell things at one part in a trillion. Imagine one drop in twenty swimming pools — that is how tiny a smell a dog can catch. When your dog wrinkles its forehead and sniffs the air, it is reading a whole world you cannot see.
blocks.title: 狗狗鼻子的秘密
blocks.cn: 科学家做过一个实验：他们训练狗狗闻出人呼气里的疾病——狗狗真的做到了！狗狗能闻到万亿分之一浓度的东西。想象一下，二十个游泳池里的一滴水——狗狗能闻到的气味就是这么微小。当你的狗狗皱起额头、嗅着空气时，它正在读一个你看不见的世界。

blocks.en: Today's idiom is "off the hook." It means you are free from a job or a trouble — you do not have to do it anymore. For example: Gaia worked for seven years, and now she is off the hook — no more rescues, naps and games! In your life: you thought you had to clean your room, but Mum says, "You are off the hook today!" Try it this week: tell your family about a time you were off the hook!
blocks.title: 今日俚语
blocks.cn: 今天的俚语是“off the hook”（脱钩）。它的意思是不用再做一件工作或不再有麻烦——你不用再做它了。举个例子：盖娅工作了七年，现在她 off the hook 了——不用再救援，只有午睡和游戏！再说说你的生活：你以为要打扫房间了，但妈妈说你今天 off the hook！这周试试用它：跟家人说说你曾经 off the hook 的一次经历！

blocks.en: Now it is your turn! Two questions for you. One: Gaia's new life is long walks and soft beds. If you adopted a hero dog, what would you do on its first day at home? Two: a dog can smell one drop in twenty swimming pools. What smell would you most like to have a dog's nose for? Talk about it with your family!
blocks.title: 结束语与互动问题
blocks.cn: 现在轮到你们啦！两个问题考考你。第一：盖娅的新生活是长长的散步和软软的床。如果你领养了一只英雄狗狗，它到家的第一天你会带它做什么？第二：狗狗能闻到二十个游泳池里的一滴水。如果你有狗狗的鼻子，你最想闻到什么气味？和家人聊聊吧！

blocks.en: That is all for today, young explorers. We appreciate you listening and learning with us. Keep your eyes open, keep asking questions, and we will meet tomorrow morning. Goodbye, and have a wonderful day!
blocks.title: 告别
blocks.cn: 今天的节目就到这里啦，小小探险家们。感谢你们和我们一起听、一起学。保持好奇，继续提问，我们明天早上再见。再见，祝你度过美好的一天！

children.text: The smelling room is full of soft tissue that traps scent, so the smell stays after the dog breathes out.
：is（是）+ full of（装满了……），意思是“里面装满了……”。full of 后面常常跟 soft tissue（柔软的组织）、water（水）、books（书）这类名词。
：that（……的）+ traps scent（留住气味），修饰前面的 tissue（组织），意思是“能留住气味的组织”。that 在这里代替 tissue，在从句里做主语。
：so（所以）+ the smell stays（气味留下来），意思是“所以气味就留下来了”。前面是原因（组织留住气味），so 后面是结果。
装满组织（is full of）→ 组织留气味（that traps scent）→ 所以气味留下（so the smell stays）
。一句话里藏着固定搭配、定语从句和结果关系三个机关。
"the rescuers could feel the person's pulse."
"It means you are free from a job or a trouble."
D. Your own translations — there is no key for this part. Read your Chinese aloud and check that it sounds natural.
